text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the existing parking prohibitions on Spruce Street, between Sumach Street and River Street, in order to generate additional on-street spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Spruce Street, between a point 30 metres east of Sumach Street and a point 15.7 metres further east. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Spruce Street, between River Street and a point 45.7 metres west. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Spruce Street, between Dyer Lane and a point 5.5 metres east. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Spruce Street, between a point 17 metres east of Dyer Lane and River Street. 5. Amended the existing permit parking regulation in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., daily, except no parking from a point 30 metres east of Sumach Street to a point 15.7 metres further east, on the even (north) side of Spruce Street, between…
